label: Crema catalana
note: Cooked on the hob (not baked) with cinnamon and lemon zest, usually thickened with cornflour, chilled, then caramelised on top; made from milk, egg yolks, sugar; cannot be frozen

about.text: A Catalan custard of milk, egg yolks and sugar with a burnt-sugar crust.
